items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: Sam Warren, you know. Sam Warren on the other side. But, uh, they all knew one area.

ctx.x: Well, I wouldn't, I wouldn't count on that either because, you know, he might not remember. I know I talked to Chris Kelly's wife about when he died, and what she said was when he was hot at the time. He couldn't remember. Did you pray in Buddy Catee's? Did he have, for the funeral? Did you pray for the funeral?

They were, he's funeral gave for Chris Kelly's funeral. Uh, Buddy had two bands. He had the Eureka band. And I got a pickup, get together band. And, uh, Chris Kelly had two bands. And, uh, Chris Kelly had two bands. And, uh, uh, he got a popper. And, uh, uh, he got a popper. And, uh, uh, he got a popper. And, uh, I just thought it was popper too. Uh, Buddy came in for a couple of Chris's. Uh, Chris was right out the country. Uh, you know, he started playing. He started a band down in the country. All them out of,…
It might have been out there, but I'm just wondering, it's very hard to establish. Well, think of this in relation to when you played with Ivan Thomas when he was murdered. That was 30.
